name: Indian Hotels

snapshot.about: Indian Hotels Company Limited operates hotels, resorts, and hospitality services across various brands globally.

narrative: Management's guidance of double-digit revenue growth matched performance, with Q4 FY26 growing 14% and full-year revenue expanding 16%. However, new business revenue growth reached 25% for FY26, missing the 30% second-half target.

promises.statement: Management expects new business growth to reach 30% in H2 FY26.

said.quote: We expect these numbers to grow from 22% to 30% in the second half of this year

actual_source.quote: Our new businesses vertical comprising Ginger, Qmin, Ama, Stays & Trails and Tree of Life delivered 25% growth in FY '26. This resulted in a consolidated revenue of INR753 crores

promises.note: Full year FY26 new business growth was 25 percent against the 30 percent H2 guidance.

promises.statement: IHCL retains guidance of double-digit revenue growth for FY26.

said.quote: IHCL remains confident of achieving its guidance of double digit revenue growth for the year driven by structural tailwinds for the industry

actual_source.quote: Full Year Revenue Growth Guidance, FY26: 16.2%
actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: FY26 capex expected to be in the Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 1,200 crore range.

said.quote: So, I think we originally guided to Rs. 1,000 crores to Rs. 1,200 crores CAPEX number. I think we are on track for that

actual_source.quote: IHCL in FY '25-'26 spent over INR1,000 crores towards capex, out of which around INR650 crores was used for renovations, routine maintenance and digital initiatives, while the rest half was used towards greenfield projects

promises.note: Management reported FY26 capex spent was over ₹1,000 crore.

promises.metric: Q3 and Q4 Topline Growth Guidance
promises.statement: Company expects both Q3 and Q4 to deliver double-digit topline growth year-on-year.

said.quote: we remain confident that in the future both Q3 and Q4 should witness double digit growth for us on the topline

actual_source.quote: On a consolidated basis, revenue for Q3 2025-26 grew 12% year-on-year to INR 2,900 crores

promises.note: Consolidated revenue grew 12 percent in Q3 FY26 and 14 percent in Q4 FY26.

said.quote: We think we should be above 12% for the quarter

said.quote: So, I would say 12% to 14% in Q4 as a topline growth is realistic

promises.statement: IHCL plans to spend approximately INR 1,000 crores in CAPEX.

said.quote: We are planning to spend approximately, we have guided on that before also, approximately INR 1,000 crores in CAPEX, which includes routine and new, and also renovation or expansion

actual_source.quote: IHCL in FY '25-'26 spent over INR1,000 crores towards capex, out of which around INR650 crores was used for renovations, routine maintenance and digital initiatives, while the rest half was used towards greenfield projects

promises.statement: Ginger and new business verticals are expected to deliver 25%+ revenue growth.

said.quote: Ginger and our new business verticals are expected to deliver 25% plus revenue growth supported by integration benefits and scale efficiencies

promises.statement: Upon stabilization, Taj Bandstand is expected to contribute INR 1,000+ crores to IHCL's topline.

said.quote: From a financial standpoint upon stabilization Taj Bandstand is expected to contribute INR 1,000 plus crores to IHCL's topline with EBITDA margins close to 50%

promises.statement: Company will continue to invest INR 1,000 crores to INR 1,200 crores annually in capex.

said.quote: Even going forward, we will continue to invest INR1,000 crores to INR1,200 crores annually to strengthen our existing competitive advantages and at the same time, build new ones

promises.statement: Management expects to sustain management fee growth at high teens CAGR.

said.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident of sustaining management fee growth at high teens CAGR, supported by a strong pipeline of hotel openings and incremental contributions from newly added hotels

promises.statement: FY27 capex expected to be around Rs. 1,200 crores.

said.quote: But you should assume anywhere between Rs. 1,200 crores for next year as well

said.quote: Importantly, these acquisitions are expected to contribute meaningfully in the range of INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores to IHCL's consolidated topline in FY’26-‘27

promises.statement: Management fee income is expected to grow in the high teens in FY27.

bull.point: Full-year FY26 revenue grew 16% to ₹9,971 crore with EBITDA margin reaching 34.9%, fulfilling double-digit revenue guidance.

evidence.quote: Other parts of our performance highlights for FY '26 is that on a consolidated basis, revenue for '25-'26 grew 16% year-on-year to INR9,971 crores
EBITDA grew 16% year-on-year to INR3,477 crores, yielding EBITDA margin of 34.9%

bull.point: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 15% year-on-year to ₹2,419 crore, backed by cash reserves of over ₹4,400 crore.

evidence.quote: Our consolidated revenue grew 15% year-on-year to INR2,419 crores
Our balance sheet continues to be healthy with gross cash reserves of over INR4,400 crores

bull.point: Operating cash flow of ₹8,891 crore over FY22 to FY26 significantly exceeded total net profit of ₹6,403 crore.

bear.point: New business growth fell short of management's 30% target for the second half of FY26, delivering 25% for the full year.
